Windows 11 Insider Builds Introduce New Xbox Shortcuts and Enhanced Search Capabilities

Key takeaways Overview Microsoft is rolling out significant updates to the search experience in Windows 11 through recent Insider builds. These updates introduce new filters, actions, and phone controls, fundamentally changing how users interact with their system's search functiona

Overview

Microsoft is rolling out significant updates to the search experience in Windows 11 through recent Insider builds. These updates introduce new filters, actions, and phone controls, fundamentally changing how users interact with their system's search functionality, particularly when in Xbox gaming mode.

Xbox Gaming Mode Shortcuts

The latest Windows 11 Insider build adds powerful new quick settings while in Xbox mode. The Xbox shortcuts allow users to control system functions like Bluetooth, WiFi, and power settings without needing to exit the gaming mode. This seamless integration means gamers can adjust their environment mid-game without interrupting their play session.

Search Improvements

The search improvements are described as comprehensive. Users can now:

  • Filter results for files, actions, or web results.
  • Use the search box to perform direct actions, such as changing screen brightness or volume.
  • Perform actions on a connected phone, including making calls.
  • Access more detailed results, such as file modification dates and authors, or pull in charts for stock prices and weather forecasts.
  • Provide feedback to train the search AI using inline thumbs-up or thumbs-down icons.

By allowing the search box to act as an action hub, Windows 11 reduces the number of clicks required to execute common tasks. Furthermore, the ability to train the search model via user feedback indicates a move toward personalized, context-aware search results.

Confirmed Information vs. Unknowns

  • Confirmed: The features are present in the latest Windows Insider builds. The specific builds available are Beta Build 26220.9836 and Experimental Build 26340.9843. The full list of changes can be found on Microsoft’s official blog post.
  • Reported/Unconfirmed: The exact timeline for when these features will roll out to all Windows 11 users remains unspecified. The depth of the phone integration (e.g., which specific communication apps are supported for calls) is not detailed in the provided source text.

Practical Implications and How to Verify

These updates make Windows 11's search significantly more proactive and integrated across devices. For gamers, the ability to tweak settings without leaving the Xbox mode saves time and preserves immersion. For general users, actionable search and expanded result details reduce the need to dig through menus. To verify these features, Windows Insiders should check the official Microsoft blog post linked in the announcement and test the new builds currently available.
